newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-SBC Warburg tips C&W shares.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-SBC Warburg tips C&W shares.

text.p: Cable and Wireless Plc, Britain's second biggest telecommunications company, should see its shares rise as it embarks on a road show to sell to institutions on both side of the Atlantic its giant cable merger with three other companies, SBC Warburg says.

The broker notes the management of C&W's majority-owned cable venture, Cable and Wireless Communications (CWC), came across well in a presentation launch on Monday despite the complexity of merging its Mercury unit with the UK cable TV subsidiaries of NYNEX Corp and Bell Canada.

"CWC faces huge challenges in integrating and growing the business to generate attractive returns on over six billion pounds of capital employed (by 1998/9) and there is likely to be healthy debate in the coming weeks about valuing the new company.
"But we believe investors reaction to management should be positive over the coming weeks," the broker added.
CWC will be Britain's biggest cable company and although it has given few financial details of the merger, it says it plans substantial synergy savings and promises to grow aggressively.

C&W rival British Telecommunications Plc saw its shares outperform and hit new year highs during its road show to sell its $22 billion planned merger with U.S. long distance carrier MCI Communications Corp.
